title: Ride now
summary: Taking a trip today, on a map: find a stop as you type, near you, or by tapping it; see what leaves next with live predictions and whether each bus is early, on time, or late, and watch it on the map; plan a trip leaving now, at a time, arriving by a time, or the last bus; see the alerts and detours in the way; keep your saved and recent stops at hand.
questions: Which stop is mine, by name or near where I am?
What leaves next from it, with real-time predictions?
Is my bus on time, late, or early?
How do I get from here to there, leaving now?
When is the last bus home?
Is there a detour or disruption on my trip or at my stop?
What leaves next from the stops I watch?
